strengths: CSS and React skills showcase expertise in building visually appealing and user-friendly web applications.
Python skills demonstrate proficiency in data analysis, machine learning, and automation, making you a valuable asset for data-driven projects.
GitHub presence highlights your ability to collaborate effectively with team members and maintain a clean, organized codebase.
weaknesses: Lack of AWS experience may make it difficult to work with cloud-based infrastructure or deploy applications on Amazon's platform.
Insufficient exposure to machine learning libraries like PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras may hinder your ability to contribute to AI-driven projects.
Inconsistent use of version control systems like Git and GitHub may lead to errors, inconsistencies, or difficulties in tracking code changes.
suggestions: Consider taking courses or attending workshops on AWS to improve your cloud computing skills and expand your career prospects.
Expand your machine learning repertoire by exploring libraries like PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras to stay competitive in the field.
Develop a consistent workflow for using Git and GitHub by creating a personal project or contributing to open-source repositories.
Practice building RESTful APIs with Flask or Django to improve your understanding of web development principles.
Participate in online communities like Reddit's r/learnpython, r/webdev, or Stack Overflow to stay updated on the latest trends and best practices.
